calls.evidence: The Advanced API Functions Reference (2026 help) describes ThisDoc.Document as returning the document in which the current rule is stored, as an Inventor.Document object.
calls.sourceQuote: Gets the document in which the current rule is stored, as an Inventor.Document object.
calls.note: Documented without any deprecation marking; only the older syntax iLogicVb.RuleDocument is mentioned as an alternative, and the docs shown are for 2026 rather than 2027.2.
